narrative_passages.title: Rain before the day of Badr

summary_for_children: Al-Anfal speaks to believers about trust in Allah, staying united, not quarrelling, and choosing peace when it is offered.
environment_concept: A wide field under a rain that steadies the ground, teaching unity, trust in Allah and the wish for peace.
architecture_and_scenery: Open plain with wells, low dunes, a camp of plain tents and a hill to look from. No battle is shown.

palette.lighting: Overcast turning to rain, then clear

areas.name: Field of Rain
areas.description: Rain falls and the sand firms under the child's feet.

areas.name: Circle of Hearts
areas.description: A circle of stones that glows when 8:2 is read.

areas.name: Hill of Peace
areas.description: A hill where a white banner of peace lifts in the breeze.

activities.name: Walk on firm ground
activities.description: Cross soft sand that becomes firm after the rain.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Don't quarrel
activities.description: Solve a teamwork puzzle that only works when every piece cooperates.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: History is told as explanation, clearly labelled; no fighting is shown.
learning_objectives: Know that Allah's help comes with patience

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
